title: On the Role of Tie-Breaking Rules in the Convergence of Fictitious Play for Symmetric First-Price Auctions
summary: We study continuous-time fictitious play in 2-bidder, symmetric first-price auctions with independently distributed discrete values and a discrete bid set. We first exhibit a minimal instance --- two bidders, two values, three positive bids --- on which fictitious play with the standard uniform-split tie-breaking rule does \emph{not} converge to the symmetric Bayes--Nash equilibrium: the equilibrium is unstable and the dynamics converge to a stable limit cycle far from the Nash equilibrium.
